text: ポケモンのふえを　ふくと　グーグー　ねむってる　ポケモンでも　げんきが　わいて　とびおきる！

structure.jp: ポケモンのふえを　ふくと
structure.en: when you play the Poké Flute

structure.jp: グーグー　ねむってる　ポケモンでも
structure.en: even a Pokémon that is snoring asleep

patterns.name: 〜と (whenever)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb means 'when this happens, that always follows'. ふくと = 'when you play it'.

patterns.name: 〜でも
patterns.explanation: でも after a thing means 'even'. ポケモンでも = 'even a Pokémon'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb says the action is going on now. Here it is shortened to てる, as people do in speech. ねむってる = 'is sleeping'.
